spoken_summary: Donald Trump states that on the issue of abortion, 'we'll get something done where everyone is going to be very satisfied.' When an off-screen interviewer asks if he means a national law, Trump replies, 'I think we'll get it done on some level. It could be on different levels. But we're going to get it done.'
